items.text:
4. ESTABLISH – STOP SIGNS
19th Street, eastbound and westbound, at Linda Street (Supervisor District 9) (Approvable by the City
Traffic Engineer) Amy Chun, [staff email removed — see the order]

Proposal to convert this intersection to an all-way STOP to address collisions.

Public Comments: Received emails in support and opposition prior to and after public hearing.
Comments in support received during public hearing citing concerns for pedestrian safety. Comments
in opposition received during public hearing with concerns for possible increased congestion on 19th



Street and difficulty backing out of residential driveways. Suggestions made for “STOP Sign Ahead”
warning signs, and for speed humps as an alternative to STOP signs.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation. #

18. ESTABLISH – NO STOPPING, EXCEPT BICYCLES
ESTABLISH – BIKE SHARE STATION
Randall Street, north side, from 7 feet to 54 feet west of Chenery Street (Supervisor District 8)
(Approvable by the City Traffic Engineer) 

Permanent legislation for the bike share station in the parking lane on the north side of Randall Street,
west of Chenery Street, adjacent to 98 Chenery, that was previously located across the street.

Public Comments: Comment received in favor of the new location, as well as parking at the former
location being problematic.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.
